query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Frankenstein, Bob gets The Odyssey, and Claire gets Ulysses.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Alice swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Finally, Bob and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Frankenstein
(B) The Odyssey
(C) Ulysses
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: Trace the exchanges step-by-step to determine which book Bob ultimately has.
To determine which book Bob has at the end of the semester, track the trading sequence: start with Alice - Frankenstein, Bob - The Odyssey, Claire - Ulysses, then record the changes after each swap.
